text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well... I've been working really, really
hard on
creating a new Japanese dessert
for my friend's
birthday party...
choice_data_list_en: What's the matter? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I kept making and taste testing a bunch
of
different desserts...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-and now I have a huge pimple on my
forehead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... What are pimples if not the
buds of
cherry blossoms...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Between her failed dessert creation and
pimple
outbreak, it seems like nothing's
going right for
poor Sakura Chiyono O.
